description.de: Als sein Vater zur See fahren muss, wird Karshian mit offenen Armen von Latias Familie aufgenommen, aber nachdem Gerüchte lautwerden, dass dieser auf See umgekommen sei, behandelt die Familie Karshian wie einen lästigen Parasiten. Angestachelt von ihren sadistischen Eltern und gierig nach Bestätigung, macht auch Latia Karshian das Leben zur Hölle. Eines Tages jedoch kehrt Karshians Vater als Held und mächtiger Herzog zurück und Karshian nimmt Rache an seinen Peinigern, indem er kurzerhand die gesamte Familie hinrichten lässt. Während ihrer eigenen Hinrichtung offenbaren Latias Eltern ihr wahres, manipulatives Gesicht. Zu ihrer Überraschung erwacht Latia daraufhin in der Vergangenheit und nimmt sich zum Ziel, ihren Tod zu verhindern und Karshian diesmal gut zu behandeln. Letzteres gestaltet sich denkbar schwierig – schließlich traut Karshian ihr absolut nicht über den Weg. Wird Latia es also schaffen, Karshian von ihrer Aufrichtigkeit zu überzeugen und Rache an ihrer Familie zu nehmen? Oder ist sie dazu verdammt, ein weiteres Mal zu sterben?
description.en: Originally, Latia's family had taken in Karshian as a favor to his father, who embarked on a maritime expedition for fame and fortune. However, after rumors begin to spread that the father had died at sea, they begin treating the young boy like a parasite. Egged on by her sadistic parents and desperate for their approval, Latia bullies Karshian relentlessly. When Karshian's father returns as a national hero and powerful duke, Karshian gets his revenge by executing Latia's entire family, including her of course! On the gallows, as her life flashes before her eyes, she realizes that her family had been lying to her and using her all along. So when she's thrown back into the past, she's determined to prevent her death and treat Karshian right this time. But this won't be easy as Karshian distrusts Latia's every move. Will Latia be able to win over Karshian and turn the tables on her family this time around, or is she doomed to die once more?
description.es: La familia de Latia acogió a Karshian cuando su padre se fue a una expedición marítima, pero después de que corrieron rumores de que estaba muerto, lo tratan como a un parásito. Instigada por sus padres sádicos y desesperada por su aprobación, Latia acosa a Karshian sin descanso. Sin embargo, cuando el padre de Karshian regresa como héroe nacional y poderoso duque, ¡Karshian se venga ejecutando a toda la familia de Latia! Mientras recuerda sus últimos momentos, se da cuenta de que su familia le había estado mintiendo todo el tiempo. Entonces, cuando es arrojada al pasado, está decidida a evitar su muerte y tratar a Karshian bien esta vez. Pero esto no será fácil cuando Karshian desconfíe de cada movimiento de Latia. ¿Podrá Latia ganarse a Karshian y darle la vuelta a su familia esta vez? ¿O está condenada a morir una vez más?
description.fr: La famille de Latia a accueilli Karshian lorsque son père est parti en expédition maritime, mais après que des rumeurs circulent selon lesquelles il est mort, ils le traitent comme un parasite. Poussée par ses parents sadiques et cherchant désespérément leur approbation, Latia intimide Karshian sans relâche. Cependant, lorsque le père de Karshian revient en tant que héros national et puissant duc, Karshian prend sa revanche en exécutant toute la famille de Latia! Alors qu'elle se remémore ses derniers instants, elle se rend compte que sa famille lui a toujours menti. Ainsi, lorsqu'elle est renvoyée dans le passé, elle est déterminée à empêcher sa mort et à traiter correctement Karshian cette fois. Mais ce ne sera pas facile lorsque Karshian se méfiera de tous les mouvements de Latia. Latia pourra-t-elle convaincre Karshian et renverser la situation avec sa famille cette fois-ci, ou est-elle condamnée à mourir une fois de plus?
description.id: Keluarga Latia menerima Karshian saat ayahnya melakukan ekspedisi laut, tetapi setelah beredar desas-desus bahwa dia sudah meninggal, mereka memperlakukannya seperti parasit. Didorong oleh orang tuanya yang sadis dan sangat membutuhkan persetujuan mereka, Latia menindas Karshian tanpa henti. Namun, ketika ayah Karshian kembali sebagai pahlawan nasional dan adipati yang kuat, Karshian membalas dendam dengan mengeksekusi seluruh keluarga Latia! Ketika dia mengingat saat-saat terakhirnya, dia menyadari bahwa keluarganya telah membohonginya selama ini. Jadi ketika dia terlempar kembali ke masa lalu, dia bertekad untuk mencegah kematiannya dan memperlakukan Karshian dengan benar kali ini. description.en:
Getting transported into a novel once? Unusual. Twice? Welcome to Ji-an Han’s reality. Her second possession lands her in the body of a noble lady with an unfortunate reputation—the court fool. While still adjusting to this twist of fate, the enigmatic Crown Prince Iskan enters the scene with an unsettling proposition: "Take me as yours," he says, "I’ll become your most cherished possession." Between her reputation as a fool and a prince whose motives remain unclear, can Ji-an navigate this complicated new reality?
___
I, Han Ji-an, was living an ordinary life in South Korea. Then one day, I woke up inside the very novel I had been reading! The real problem? This is my second time transmigrating, and I’ve ended up as a completely different character. Worse yet... I’ve become the duchess known as a fool?!?! While I’m still reeling from the shock, the imperial prince of this world, Grand Duke Iskan Anagrock, shows up...

“You’re telling me I was your lover? That’s impossible!”

“Take me. I will surely become your most prized possession.”

As if being stuck as a fool wasn’t bad enough, now I have to deal with this unreadable man... Can I really survive here?
description.fr: Han Ji-an vivait une vie ordinaire en Corée du Sud avant de se réveiller un beau matin dans l’univers d’une de ses lectures… Pour la deuxième fois de sa vie! Puisque le sort a décidé de s’acharner sur elle, Ji-an incarne cette fois-ci la jeune Delinda Schultz, tristement connue sous le nom de «Lady crétine.» Comme si ça ne suffisait pas, le mystérieux Iskan Anagrok, grand-duc de l’empire de Vakian, la suit de près et lui fait une étrange proposition… Désormais experte malgré elle de la transmigration, Ji-an arrivera-t-elle à survivre aux nombreuses péripéties qui l’attendent?
description.id: Han Jian yang awalnya menjalani kehidupan normal, tiba-tiba 'masuk' ke dalam novel yang sedang dia baca. Masalahnya ini adalah 'perpindahan jiwa'-nya yang kedua kali! Ditambah lagi, karakter yang menampung jiwanya ini dikenal sebagai putri yang 'bodoh'! Di tengah kebingungannya, muncul seorang pangeran di dunia novel ini yakni Grand Duke Iskan Anagrok. Pria itu pun menunjukkan ketertarikannya pada putri 'bodoh' tersebut! Bisakah Jian bertahan hidup di dunia ini?
description.ko:

혼란스러운 와중 이 세계의 황자, 이스칸 아나그로크 대공이 나타나는데...

The Chilseok festival is coming soon and there will be a gathering at the Hotel Ojakgyo to celebrate the event. However, in reality, the event is actually for alphas and omegas come together to have an orgy!  
  
Im E-Jun is a rare, high- quality omega. Omegas of his stature are desired by many. Even so, Im E-Jun has always liked his close friend, Kang Do-hoon, who is an alpha. However, Sihun, another alpha, has his eyes set on Im E-Jun.  
  
What is to happen when the day of the festival finally comes?

An orphan boy, named Murang, has always wanted to be a dragon rider - but people always assume the worst of him because he is a parentless. Always getting beat up for riding the village dragons, he is consistently looking for ways to climb his way into becoming a full-fledged dragon rider. Luckily, he finds an isolated dragon-egg. But would that be enough to change his life for the better? A story-tale of a dragon rider.

Starting from her 8th birthday, she had a long dream that lasted for 10 years. The dream finished with ended with the death of her real mother... When things started to repeat the way they did in her dreams, she ran away to meet with the Empress in order to survive. However, in doing so she accidentally ran into Rud On, her half-brother and the Crown Prince, who hated her real mother, the King's Concubine. 

"The moment I thought I was wrong. He held out his hand to me,  'Can I stay here? 'Because this is your room now.' Why are people nice to me?"

The story follows a princess from the kingdom of Elbern, who was sacrificed to seal the demon king. She awakens 300 years later in the northern part of the continent. Deciding to live a new life as a commoner named Serena, she takes a job as a maid at the infamous Valois Duke's castle, rumored to be a terrifying place. There, she encounters a sharp-tongued but endearing girl and the Duke of Valois, known as the "Battlefield Butcher." The narrative explores her journey of adaptation, survival, and the mysteries surrounding her new life.

description.de: Nach dem plötzlichen Tod ihrer Mutter erwacht in der jungen Aika eine außergewöhnliche Gabe: Die Fähigkeit, in die Zukunft zu blicken. Doch die Bilder, die sie verfolgen, sind alles andere als ein Segen. Immer wieder sieht sie denselben grausamen Moment – den Tod ihres Onkels Kassel. Entschlossen, dieses Schicksal abzuwenden, ernennt sich Aika kurzerhand zu Kassels persönlichem Schutzengel und zieht bei ihm ein. Doch der Plan hat einen gewaltigen Haken: Kassel sieht ihrer Mutter zwar verblüffend ähnlich, doch hinter der vertrauten Fassade verbirgt sich ein Herz aus Eis. Er ist das exakte Gegenteil der Wärme, die Aika so schmerzlich vermisst. Während die Schatten des Todes immer näher rücken, beginnt für Aika ein gefährliches Spiel gegen die Zeit. Sie merkt schnell: Sein Leben zu retten ist eine Sache – aber sein Herz zu gewinnen, ist der wahre Kampf.
description.en:
A girl with foresight is sent to live with her cold, villainous uncle after her mother’s death.

Determined to save him from a dark future, she clings to him only to find roles reversed as he grows emotionally dependent. 

With a possessive childhood friend and a desperate father added to the chaos, her simple mission spirals out of control.
___
Aika is a 7-year-old girl who can see the future, and after losing her beloved mother in an accident, she is sent to live with her notoriously bad-tempered uncle, Kassel.    
Though he couldn't care less about her at first, Aika is determined to save his life after foreseeing his tragic future. But eventually, her uncle starts to get clingy, her sweet childhood friend becomes obsessive, and the father she had never known suddenly shows up and asks her for another chance. Will Aika be able to save her uncle with everything going on?
description.fr: Après la mort de sa mère, la jeune Aika hérite d'un don extraordinaire : la capacité de voir l'avenir. Mais son nouveau pouvoir ne cesse de lui montrer des visions de son oncle, Kassel, fauché par la mort. Déterminée à sauver sa famille, Aika s'installe chez lui et se fait le serment de le protéger. Il y a pourtant un problème de taille : si Kassel a les traits de sa mère, sa personnalité glaciale en est l'exact opposé. Alors que le danger se rapproche, Aika se bat pour le garder en vie. Mais elle réalise vite qu'arracher son oncle à la mort est bien plus facile que de conquérir son cœur.
description.ko:

내 이름은 아이카, 나이는 일곱 살.
특별한 게 있다면… 예지 능력이 있다는 것 정도?

***

사랑하는 엄마를 사고로 잃고, 삼촌에게 맡겨졌는데,
삼촌은 이 넓은 제국에서도 성격이 더럽기로 유명한 '악당'이었다.

"나한테 애 키우는 취미는 없어. 알아서 쥐 죽은 듯이 지내라?"

엄마를 쏙 빼닮은 삼촌이 나를 냉대하는 건 마음이 아팠지만,
삼촌이 위험해지는 미래를 본 이상 이대로 물러날 생각은 없다.
삼촌한테 껌딱지가 뭔지 제대로 보여주겠어.
…그랬는데, 어라?

"진짜 삼촌 버리고 갈 거야? 너 없이 삼촌 어떻게 살라고."
이젠 삼촌이 내 껌딱지가 되고,

"나는 너 외에 다른 생각은 할 수조차 없어."
순하기만 했던 소꿉친구가 집착하고,

얼굴도 모르는 아빠까지 나타나 애원한다?

구하겠다고 했지만, 이렇게까지 할 생각은 없었다고!
description.ru:
Секретная миссия — спасти дядю-неженку!
Я Айка, мне семь лет.
Пожалуй, моя особенность — дар предвидения.
После потери любимой мамы в аварии, меня передали на попечение дяде, известному своим отвратительным характером и репутацией злодея в этой огромной Империи.
«Я не увлекаюсь воспитанием детей. Веди себя тихо, как мёртвая крыса.»
Больно, что дядя, так похожий на маму, холоден со мной… Но, увидев его опасное будущее, я не собиралась сдаваться.
Покажу ему, что значит быть прилипалой.
…Но что происходит?
«Ты правда собираешься бросить дядю? Как же мне жить?»
Теперь дядя стал прилипалой.
«Я могу думать только о тебе.»
Мой милый друг детства начал проявлять одержимость.
«Можешь ли ты дать мне ещё один шанс?»
Даже папа, лицо которого не знаю, появляется и умоляет?
Я собиралась спасти дядю, не думая, что всё зайдёт так далеко!

그에게 계약 결혼이 필요할 때, 자신을 떠올릴 수 있도록!

“나랑 결혼하고 싶다고 시도 때도 없이 조를 땐 언제고…….”

내 살 길 찾으면서 원작 내용을 이용해 가며 열심히 살아가는데.

One day, Sungyoon runs into famous author, Seo Hyunsoo, by chance at a bookstore. When Sungyoon and Hyunsoo were in high school, they had a close senior-junior relationship, but then Hyunsoo one-sidedly cut off all contact with Sungyoon! To celebrate their reunion, they both have drinks together but the next morning, Hyunsoo faints due to alcohol poisoning. After finding out that Hyunsoo has fallen into a slump, Sungyoon feels guilty and declares that he will help him. For the sake of the romance in his novel, Hyunsoo unexpectedly suggests for them to be contract lovers…!  
   
A ‘contract’ that will only last until his novel ends.  
What will be the ending of their relationship…?

description.en:
I've been reincarnated as the extra character who stalked her husband, the male lead, for 10 years and died. Of course, I tried to divorce him before the female lead appeared.

But, I found out that my young husband's household was secretly abusing him. At that moment, I immediately became overwhelmed with the responsibility and sense of duty a modern adult would have. 

***

Aiden had his back turned away from her and suddenly grabbed her arm forcefully. The strength of his hands alone could have ripped her arms off. Erin timidly called his name and spoke. 

"I already reminded you yesterday. We're a married couple, so I'm always on your side." 

"..."

"So, everything is alright." 

She comforted him with these sweet words like it was a spell. And as if he was under her magic, Aiden stopped trembling. 

***

The adult Erin requested to divorce her husband Aiden before the female lead appeared. As soon as those words left her lips, Aiden's smile disappeared. 

"A divorce? Never."

Aiden tore the divorce papers into such thin sheets, the contents were no longer legible. Erin smiled at the sight.
description.ko:
남주이자 남편을 무려 10년 동안 스토킹 하다가 죽는 서브여주에 빙의했다.
당연히 살고 싶어서 진짜 여주가 나타나기 전에 곱게 이혼해 주려고 했다.
그런데 아직 어린 남편이 가문의 편견과 압박 속에서 아무도 모르게 은밀한 학대를 받고 있다는 사실을 알게 되었다.
그 순간 그녀가 현대인으로서 가지고 있는 어른으로서의 책임과 의무감이 자극됐다.

***

에이든이 등을 돌린 채 자신의 팔을 꽉 쥐고 있었다.
손아귀 힘만으로도 팔을 뜯어낼 수 있을 만큼 강한 힘으로.
엘린이 조심스럽게 그의 이름을 부르며 말을 꺼냈다.

“내가 어제 말했지. 우리는 부부니까, 나는 네 편이라고.”
“…….”
“그러니까 괜찮아.”

주문처럼 위로를 속삭였다.
그리고 아주 천천히, 에이든의 떨림이 잦아들기 시작했다.

***

어른이 된 엘린은 진짜 여주인공이 나타나기 전, 에이든에게 이혼을 선언했다.
그러자 조금 전까지 웃고 있던 에이든의 얼굴이 돌변했다.

“이혼이라니. 절대 안 돼.”

에이든은 순식간에 이혼 서류를 갈기갈기 찢어 형체를 알아볼 수 없는 가루로 만들어버렸다.
그 상황을 바라보던 엘린의 입꼬리가 조용히 씰룩였다.

description.en:
In a time of chaos and war, a godforsaken era, twin sons are born to an emperor. But legend states that the son of the emperor shall be born a demon! But twins? Who is the demon, and who shall reign as emperor?  
  
Chunchu is the story of a young man saved from death by his mother, banished by his people, hunted by his brother, and tortured by the demons within. Living and fighting with a low-born warrior tribe who can never trust him, Chunchu lives a life of blood and violence, every day a struggle to survive. But something mysterious lurks within his cold exterior, something that could be awakened by the touch of a woman.  
  
* Manhwa of the Year in Korea-2003.

Do (beep) with me. Why would I, you lunatic!  
  
A story about the messy cohabitation of the Lord Devil, who has come to the human realm searching for a bride, and the male student who falls under his radar.

At the command of the Bodhisattva of Mercy, the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, Sun Wukong, returns to the human world.
But everything has changed. The demons have disappeared, and powerful martial artists now rule the land.
As Sun Wukong roams this new world, searching for his lost master’s soul, he becomes entangled with the reincarnations of his old allies and uncovers the hidden truths of the martial arts world.
A grand conspiracy unfolds—former demons reborn as humans, secret techniques long forgotten, and a power struggle that threatens the balance of the world.

'I wish I'd never been reborn as a twin from the royal family.'

This was the only wish in my heart on the night I was framed and died. To think I would be betrayed by my twin older sister whom I believed was destined to be my better half.

However, why on earth did I return to the past out of nowhere! I'm just an ordinary citizen who never dreamed of defeating my chosen older sister! I really, really didn't, but...

"Oh my, wawawa! Has our cutie pie baby daughter awwived?"
A mother who becomes a fool for her beloved daughter.

"Dada... Did you say it, baby?"
A father who's a crybaby when it comes to me.

"Can... I give you a hug, too?"
My mom's first knight, who was called both a mad dog and a loyal dog.

"Bicbic! Beepp!"
A bird which almost lost its life and was saved.

"Only your highness is the owner of my heart now."
The top nobleman of the kingdom whom my 7 year-old sister had a crush on.

"Become the first holy king to manage the wizard."
The crazy wizard called God's mistake.

"I promise I will choose you forever."
Even the prince of an enemy country...

Everyone is on my side.

At this point, isn't it worth giving it a try?

This is the story of a twin sister who has to defeat her older twin against all odds. It is a child care story and the survival of a twin princess!

“오구구구, 우리 딸 와쩌여?”

딸바보 엄마와 짠내 나는 아빠야 그렇다 치고

“마법사를 부리는 최초의 신성 왕이 되어 봐.” 신의 실수라 불리던 미친 마법사,
“영원히 그대를 선택하기로 약속합니다.” 적국이었던 제국의 황태자까지도,

모두 모두 내 편이다?
이쯤 되면 한번 해 볼 만하지 않습니까?

예지자 언니를 이기고 아등바등 살아남을 쌍둥이 동생의 이야기.

When the reader wakes up as Lianna, a villainess in a fantasy novel, she discovers that she’s the only person who can touch the tyrannical Emperor Enoch without activating his fatal ice curse. As his only cure, she must heal him while surviving the imperial court and the schemes of her cruel family. But as she peels back the layers of Enoch’s cold facade, she finds a lonely man, and soon their roles as the cursed and the cure blossom into a world-altering romance.
description.ko:
19금 피폐 소설 <그 공녀는 왜 장미정원을 뒹굴었을까> 속 악역으로 빙의했다.

그때까지만 해도 꼼짝없이 죽었다고 생각했다.
에녹 필리프 디하르트. 그는 남과 닿는 걸 미치도록 싫어하는 폭군이었으니까.

“오늘은 만져주기로 약속했지 않습니까. 옷도 벗기기 쉬운 거로 입어 봤는데.”

조금 독특한 취향을 가지고 있는 것 같기도 하고.

“제 모든 처음은 당신이었습니다. 그러니 리아나, 당신에게도 제가 그런 사람이면 좋겠습니다.”

description.en:
A man who has lost his beloved family.   
A desperate time travel to save his family begins.

Angela, who was born in a completely different world while retaining memories of her past life, embarks on her second life. 

She wishes to share the tales written by Andersen, her favorite fairy tale author in her past life. Angela establishes a publishing company and successfully publishes his fairy tales, thriving in her endeavors. 

However... 

"This doesn't make sense!"
"What doesn't make sense?"

To her surprise, Andersen also exists in this world! And not just any Andersen, but a callous and handsome one.

Angela jumps at the opportunity to recruit a writer for the first time in her life. Despite leading a stable life as a knight hailing from an esteemed noble family, Andersen actually possesses a talent so brilliant like a jewel.

"Author, please sign a (lifetime) contract with me!"

A romance fantasy even more enchanting than a fairy tale, <The Author I Stole>.

Ryeon knew from the moment she was born that her life was a cursed one. Born sickly in a martial arts family meant she had nothing else to do other than wait for death. And when that icy embrace came, it delivered not peace but a second chance at life! Regressed to her days as a child, Ryeon resolves to cure herself and live a long, healthy life for the sake of herself and her family.

---
After seven years of dormancy, “Ryeon,” the young version of Danmok Ryan who returned after witnessing her death, wakes up. Suddenly, a strange message appears before her: “Keep the life force level below 50. If this condition persists for two months or more, it will lead to death.” Unable to build her abilities, “Ryeon” must rid herself of the life force accumulating in her body. Meanwhile, “Chin Hwa Reonya,” the young future head of the Machin Temple, confronts her, wondering why he serves in her household and is two years younger than her. Additionally, the chicken turns into a hawk, and the cat into a bakho. With a series of unexpected surprises, can “Ryeon” live a happy life in this new existence?
description.fr: Ryeon, la fille aînée de la famille Danmok, qui a été détruite par le groupe maléfique des Sanguinaires, meurt après avoir souffert toute sa vie d’une maladie chronique. Un jour, elle retourne en enfance par réincarnation. Dotée d’un incroyable pouvoir surnaturel, qui lui permet d’obtenir des informations sur les gens rien qu’en les regardant, Ryeon utilise ses connaissances passées et ses nouvelles capacités pour sauver sa famille et ses proches.

7년 만에 깨어난 단목세가의 장손 단목련.
자신의 죽음 이후까지 보고 돌아온 그녀 앞에

몸에 비축되는 영기를 어떻게든 발산해야만 하는데…
엎친데 덮친 격으로,
눈앞에 놓인 것은 몰락해서 '단목 씨'가 되기 직전인 세가.

“내 무병장수를 방해하는 건 다 없애 버릴 테다!”

그렇게 단목세가를 재건하려는 찰나.

심지어 나보다 두 살 어렸어?

게다가 닭을 키우니 봉황이 되고,

과연 단목련은 이번 생에 오래오래 행복하게 살수 있을까?

description.en: The protagonist, Boreum Park, is the daughter of a goddess and a womanizing taoist. Stolen from her mother at birth, she lives on earth with her father Chun Park. Her whereabouts are hidden from her mother by the protective charms set up around their house and she is always forbidden to leave them. When on the prowl for women one day, her casanova father comes across a man playing the flute. As they get to know each other he falls in love with the man. In order to stay close to the man he offers a marriage proposal for Boreum to marry the man's son. Thus stirring things up in the heavens when her mother finally finds Boreum's whereabouts.

description.en:
I, the sole daughter of a villain, was pitifully abandoned in the snow by my father due to my lack of ability. The male lead’s father saved me, bringing me back with him.

If they discovered I was the daughter of a villain, I would definitely be killed. I’d run away, but because I am only a newborn baby, I need someone to take care of me before I can step out into the world.

Well, I suppose there’s no choice but to flirt with the male lead’s father!

“Papa!”

Come here~ Come take care of me~
Am I not cute? You can’t leave me alone when I’m so lovely, right?

He stared at me, unable to stop himself from falling to my charm.

“C-cute.”

Hmm? Papa, weren’t you acting so cold before?

---

Is it because she made a pact with the Demon King or that she was saved by Agnos, leader of the rival House Ardelos? Or maybe it’s because I reincarnated as Lireis, and I know what’s fated to come! It was the start of a possession that began with a typical regretful family drama. After cutting ties with a family that doesn't get along with each other, I thought a peaceful unemployed life was waiting for me.

However...

For some reason, men who had no interest in me before the possession started creeping in.

"I have something I like."
"What is it?"
"It's you, Lora."

The slave who I brought because I felt sorry for him getting beat up now confessed.

"Why doesn't Laura take care of herself? I'll take care of her from now on."

The condition of the butler, who is of mixed race, became strange.

"Lora, will you marry me?"

The Grand Duke, who used to threaten me, proposed.

"Haa, this sweet smell... you're the first one to drive me this crazy."

This crazy man seems even crazier.

...I wish they'd all just disappear.

Han Seo-ha is a warrior who fought to the end against the evil empress who ruled the world. She died in a final battle, but woke up in the past, the day she entered a portal called “Gate Dragon”. This portal was actually a virtual reality game that took people to a fantasy world full of monsters and dangers.

 She decided to use her knowledge of the future to survive and change the fate of the world but, she will have to face many obstacles and enemies who tried to stop her, Seo-ha will also find several allies and friends who helped her on her journey.

description.en: Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn’t it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That’s what Jiwoo is looking forward to… But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dongchan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dongchan isn’t the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn’t want Jiwoo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Jiwoo tries his best to adjust to life in the country…until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit? (Source: Lezhin)
description.fr: La vie à la campagne est censée être idyllique, non ? Un endroit paisible rempli d'aimables voisins au grand cœur, pas vrai ? C'est ce que Jiwoo attend avec impatience... Mais de tous les voisins qu'il aurait pu avoir, c'est Dongchan qu'il est le sien. Froid, distant et insondable, Dongchan n'est pas le plus accueillant du voisinage. En fait, on dirait qu'il n’a pas du tout envie que Jiwoo et sa famille s’installent ici. Déconcerté mais pas découragé, Jiwoo fait de son mieux pour s'adapter à la vie à la campagne... jusqu'à ce qu'il s'avère que quelqu'un essaie de chasser sa famille d'ici. Jiwoo a des soupçons, mais sera-t-il capable de trouver le vrai coupable ?

description.en: Jihyuk doesn’t do boyfriends, only one-night stands. So, when he’s on the prowl one night for someone to warm his bed…he gets punched in the face instead. The reason? He’s a beta and if you haven’t heard, betas aren’t exactly in demand right now. While he’s nursing his wound in the bathroom, someone falls out of one of the stalls. It is an alpha and one clearly in rut. Jihyuk is about to call the ambulance when the alpha tells him there’s only one thing he needs: a beta. Well, that can be easily arranged. But is Jihyuk prepared to get down and dirty to help the mysterious alpha? And why does the alpha look so familiar? But more importantly, will this one-night shenanigans end at that or will this force Jihyuk to break his own rules?

"Charlhein is my true love."

"Isn’t Charlhein your adopted daughter?"

"We did that to protect her from attacks within the house. It was a helpless situation. She’ll become the lady of this house when Father passes away. Everyone in the Barony already knows."

"Then, what about me?"

Eliana, the eldest daughter of a poor noble family, accepted a marriage proposal from Baron Carmen in order to take care of her siblings and the household. However, as soon as she got married, she heard news that came out of nowhere. Additionally, because of Charlhein's scheming, people started calling Eliana by the disgraceful title of "stepmother."

She couldn't let it go, so she decided to use her stepmother image to turn the crisis into an opportunity.

Her goal is to be the queen of the harem.

It's not about her sweet love—it's a warlike shortcut to power. 

Alongside this dangerous harem-building, will she be able to exact revenge and find true love?
description.ko:
“내 진정한 사랑은 샤르헨이오.”
“샤르헨은 당신의 수양딸 아닌가요?”
“집안의 공격으로부터 목숨을 지키기 위해 어쩔 수 없는 조치였소. 아버지가 돌아가시면 그녀가 이 집안의 안주인이 될 것이오. 이미 이 남작가에 있는 모두가 알고 있소.”
“그럼, 저는요?”

가난한 귀족 가문의 장녀인 엘리아나는 동생들의 뒷바라지와 집안을 위해 카르만 남작의 청혼을 받아들이지만, 결혼하자마자 청천벽력 같은 소리를 듣는다. 게다가 샤르헨의 계략에 의해 악독한 계모라는 오명까지 쓰게 되는데.

이대로 당할 순 없었던 엘리아나는 위기를 기회로 만들고자, 자신을 둘러싼 온갖 소문들을 적극적으로 이용하기로 결심한다.

그녀의 목표는 하렘의 여왕.
그것은 그녀에게 달콤한 사랑이 아닌, 전쟁 같은 권력을 쟁취하기 위한 지름길이다. 이 위험한 하렘 건설 속 그녀는 복수를 이루고, 진정한 사랑을 찾을 수 있을까?

A woman identical to me appears in my dreams, crying.

For three years, Shunaelle, the Demon King of the North, has been haunted by the same dream, growing curious about the woman and deciding to track her down.  

The truth? She’s a fragment of Shunaelle’s soul, cast away into the human realm.  

When Shunaelle tries to absorb the fragment back into herself, the woman resists.  

『I don’t want to be absorbed!』  

Instead, she makes a plea:  
If you want me back, live my life—a life filled with regret—and make it right.

Sie war die vom Orakel vorherbestimmte künftige Kaiserin und die einzige Tochter der angesehenen Herzogsfamilie Goldwin. Doch in der Hochzeitsnacht wird ihr behütetes Leben auf den Kopf gestellt. Noch schlimmer ist jedoch, dass sie fortan an unheilbaren Kopfschmerzen und Schlaflosigkeit leidet, die sogar ihr Leben bedrohen. description.en:
"From the embrace of the golden lion, the sun’s destined companion shall arise."  

On the day Eira Goldwyn was born, a prophecy foretold she would become the Empress. But on her wedding night with the Crown Prince…  

"Are you truly the woman of the prophecy?"  

The golden mark, said to appear only on the chosen one, fails to manifest. Cast aside and humiliated, Eira is unilaterally rejected by the Crown Prince.  

With rumors branding her as an illegitimate child, relatives scheming to seize her family’s legacy while her father lies gravely ill, and relentless headaches and insomnia leaving her vulnerable, Eira's life spirals into chaos.  

Until one fateful evening. At the Twinveil social club in the capital, Eira encounters a man who holds the cure to her afflictions.  

"I’ve found him. My remedy."  

With his help, Eira vows to reclaim everything she lost—her honor, her family’s legacy, and her rightful place in the prophecy.
___
Aylah Goldwyn’s destiny had been determined since her birth: she was to marry the crown prince. However, on the day after her wedding, the prince asks for their marriage to be dissolved. Now, she suffers from near-constant headaches and insomnia, made bearable only through the embrace of a man. One night, she discovers a man who can make her headaches disappear entirely with nothing but a touch. But the next morning, she discovers that he left without a word, and she doesn’t even know his name. Will she be able to find this mysterious man, her “cure”?
description.es: El destino de Eira Goldwyn de casarse con el príncipe heredero estaba decidido desde su nacimiento. Sin embargo, al día siguiente de su boda, el príncipe pidió la disolución del matrimonio. Ahora sufre de insomnio y dolores de cabeza casi constantes, soportables solo con el abrazo de un hombre. Una noche, Eira conoce a un hombre capaz de hacer desaparecer sus dolores de cabeza por completo con solo una caricia. Pero a la mañana siguiente, descubre que se ha ido sin decir palabra, y ni siquiera sabe su nombre. ¿Podrá Eira volver a encontrar a su "cura"?
description.fr:
«De l’étreinte du lion d’or naîtra la compagne du soleil.»

Le jour de la naissance d’Eira Goldwin, l’oracle annonça qu’elle deviendrait impératrice. Mais lors de sa nuit de noces avec le prince héritier, la marque dorée — signe incontestable de l’élue — ne se manifesta pas. Humiliée, elle est répudiée sans ménagement. Accusée d’être une bâtarde, trahie par sa propre famille et affaiblie par d’insupportables migraines, Eira perd tout: son avenir, son honneur, et même la protection de sa maison. Jusqu’au jour où, dans un salon mondain de la capitale, elle croise un homme capable d’apaiser sa douleur. Pour Eira, il devient plus qu’un simple remède: il est la clé pour reconquérir ce qui lui a été arraché — sa dignité, et la gloire de son nom.
description.id: Sejak kecil, Eira Goldwyn ditakdirkan untuk menikah dengan putra mahkota. Tanpa diduga, pada malam pertama Eira dan sang putra mahkota, pria tersebut tidak jatuh cinta kepadanya. Pernikahan tersebut pun dibatalkan hanya sehari setelahnya. Setahun kemudian, reputasi Eira hancur dan ia menderita sakit kepala dan insomnia yang tak kunjung sembuh. Hampis setiap malam, ia mencari obat di Tweenveil, sebuah “klub malam”. Namun, obat yang dapat menyembuhkan Eira dari penyakitnya adalah… pria tampan?
description.ko:
‘황금 사자의 품에서 태양의 반려가 탄생하리라.’

에이라 골드윈이 태어난 날, 신탁은 에이라가 황후가 될 것을 점지했다.
하지만 황태자와의 첫날밤…

“정녕 공녀가 신탁의 여인이 맞습니까?”

신탁의 여인에게만 나타난다는 금빛 각인은 나타나지 않고,
에이라는 황태자에게 일방적으로 파혼당한다.

에이라를 사생아로 몰아가는 소문들과,
아버지가 쓰러진 틈에 가문을 차지하려는 친척들.
그 사이에서 에이라는 극심한 두통과 불면증 탓에 그들에게 무력하게 당하고 만다.

그러던 어느 날.
수도의 사교 클럽, 트윈베일로 향한 에이라는
그곳에서 자신의 두통을 낫게 해줄 남자를 만난다.

‘찾았다. 내 치료제.’

에이라는 그의 도움을 받아 잃어버린 모든 것을 되찾을 것이다.
자신과, 가문의 명예 모두.
description.ru:
«Объятия льва явят миру новую любимицу солнца».

В день рождения Эйлы Голдвин пророчество возвестило о скором восхождении девушки на место императрицы, однако в первую брачную ночь с наследным принцем...

«Действительно ли графиня — та самая, выбранная пророчеством?»

Золотая метка, которая, согласно преданию, должна проявиться только у избранной женщины, так и не показалась, из-за чего героиня оказывается грубо отвергнутой им.

После произошедшего начинают расползаться слухи, что Эйла — незаконнорожденная дочь, что порождает вражду за власть среди её родственников, пока глава и отец барышни остаётся прикованным к постели. Так она, измученная невыносимыми головными болями с бессоницей и бесконечной грызнёй, становится беззащитной перед их напором.

Но однажды...

Эйла решает отправиться в столичный светский клуб «Твинвейл», где встречает мужчину, способного излечить её боли.

«Ах, вот и моё долгожданное лекарство...»

С помощью него протагонистка возвращает всё, что некогда утратила: и себя настоящую, и честь своего рода.

Сумеет ли героиня в итоге обрести своё счастье?

Rain befinder sich einer Zeitschleife und erlebt wieder und wieder das Leben, das sie führt, nachdem ihre Mutter sie verläßt und letztendlich stirbt. Die Probleme laßen nicht lang auf sich warten: Ihre adlige Adoptivfamilie möchte den aktuellen Herrscher des Landes stürzen! Hierfür nutzen sie magischen Kräfte, um dem Herrscher Alpträume in den Kopf zu pflanzen. Rain besitzt jedoch ebenfalls Kräfte und hat die Fähigkeit, disen Fluch rüchgängig zu machen. Die Rettung des Königreiches liegt damit in ihren Händen. Wird sie das Königreich und ihr eigenes Leben dieses Mal retten können?

description.en:
In contrast to her past life in Korea, the storybook world Rayne Haatz inhabits is full of wonders—think dreamy powers, nobles inspired by card suits, and anthromorphs. There’s just one issue… her destiny in this world is to die! Luckily, it seems that someone wants her alive. In her fourth life, Rayne vows to stop her scheming family from giving Emperor Jaynen the dark nightmares that drive him mad and lead to her death. But after three deaths, has Rayne learned enough to change her fate? Or will her feelings for Jaynen complicate her plans?

description.fr:
Coincée dans une boucle de résurrection qui semble sans fin, c'est la troisième fois qu'elle se réveille dans le même roman, au même moment! Après tant d’existences passées à essayer d'aider sa noble famille d'adoption dans ses méfaits et à en mourir à chaque fois, elle décide de changer de stratégie. Dans cette vie, elle va aider l'empereur et le protéger des pouvoirs maléfiques de ses proches! Si eux peuvent le rendre fou en implantant des cauchemars dans son esprit, notre héroïne, elle, peut manger ces rêves destructeurs. Encore faut-il garder la tête froide quand les sentiments s'en mêlent. Connaîtra-t-elle assez l’histoire pour la changer?

description.ko:
회귀를 거듭하면서 나에겐 꿈을 먹는 능력이 생겼다.
악몽에 시달리다 흑화 해버리는 황제를 구하기엔 딱이다.
황제에게 악몽을 심는 흑막 하츠 가문,
그 가문이 바로 내 가문이라는 것만 빼면 더 수월할 텐데.
흑막 가문의 엑스트라로서 분노한 황제에게 죽임당하길 여러 번.
이번 삶에서는 살기 위해 정체를 숨기고 직접 황제를 구해보는 거야...!

"호, 혹시 도를 믿으십니까?!"
길에서 만난 그에게 접근하는 방법은 조금 독특했을지 몰라도...
"정신이 멍하고, 악몽인 듯하지만 기억나지 않는 꿈도 꾸고, 마치 어둠에 먹힐 것 같지 않나요?!"
"그런 것들이... 도라는 걸 믿으면 좋아지나?"

역시 '도를 믿으십니까'라는 이 세계에서도 뿌리치기 어렵다니까.
자, 저만 믿고 따라오세요.

description.en:
Leah has been dreaming of a happy marriage. She has had two tries at her luck, but both times the engagements ended. When she got engaged for the third time she was determined that this time it was going to last. Even though she is determined, she keeps seeing a man called Julien with whom she got familiar prior to her engagement. Julien's proposal, combined with his kind personality and handsome face, made her swoon and she agreed to marry him.  

After their wedding, she was enjoying her honeymoon in Julien's estate, where she discovers traces of herself that she didn't know he had. She enters Julien's secret room that he had been hiding from her...

description.ko:
무림 천하오대세가 중 하나인 <남궁세가>의 둘째 아들인 남궁서휘는 가족과의 불화로 집을 뛰쳐나가고 5년 만에 돌아온다.
아버지와 형인 남궁서윤에게 상처 주는 일을 서슴지 않고,
작은 실수를 했다는 이유로 시녀에게 칼을 휘두르려 했을 정도로 망나니였던 서휘는 가출 후 만난 낭인에 의해 혈교에 팔려가고,
그곳에서 있던 비밀 실험의 실험대가 되고, 폭발 사고로 이세계인 <신성 가이아>의 라플레시아 대륙으로 가게 된다. 
그 세계의 15년을 살게 되지만, 신성 가이아의 인과율에서 벗어난 존재였던 서휘는 성장하지 않은 채로 이세계에서 살아간다.
이세계에서 서휘는 소중한 친우를 만나게 되고, 엄청난 수준의 마법을 부리는 강력한 힘을 지니게 된다.
또한 그 15년의 경험을 통해 망나니였던 15세와는 전혀 다른 성숙한 내면을 갖게 된다. 
그렇기에 무림의 시간으로 5년 만에 돌아온 서휘는 5년 전과 다르지 않은 외모를 지녔음에도 불구하고 전혀 다른 성격으로 아버지와 형에게 응석을 부리기도 하고,
식솔들에게 예를 갖추는 모습을 보여 남궁세가의 사람들을 놀라게 만든다.
그러나 그 내면에는 자신에게 적의를 드러낸 사람들을 주저 없이 죽일 수 있는 잔혹함을 지니고 있으며,
상대방을 철저하게 굴복시켜 무릎 꿇게 만드는 흉포함이 감춰져 있었다. 순진하고 어리게만 느껴지는 서휘를 지키려는 남궁서윤이지만,
서휘는 그런 형이 알지 못하도록 뒤에서 남궁서윤과 집안의 적을 철저하게 제거한다.
이세계인 라플레시아 대륙에서 자신의 친우인 아스밀리온을 황제로 만들 만큼 강력한 남궁서휘가 이번에는 무림에서 자신이 뜻하는 바를 펼치게 되고,
무림은 강력한 이형의 힘을 사용하는 서휘로 인해 크게 움직이게 된다.
